Chapter 01 · Before We Met
Before We Met
A Girl Growing Up
Somewhere in the world, a little girl was growing up full of wonders—a warm, quiet spark that would one day change everything for someone like me, who had not yet found her. She was becoming herself beautifully and unknowingly, long before our story had a name.
once upon a time ✦ miracle always & forever

✨ before our story had a name ✨

Chapter 02 · 6th Class
6th Class
The Moment I Was Startled
It was a dance activity at school—ordinary in every way—until she walked in. I still remember that feeling—something between surprise and wonder—like the room had quietly rearranged itself around her. I did not know what to call it then; I just knew I could not look away.
be mine ✦ startled by you true love
✦
✨ the room rearranged itself ✨
scroll
Chapter 03 · 8th Class
8th Class
The Space Between Us
I told her how I felt, and the world shifted. What followed was a quiet drifting apart—not out of cruelty, but out of awkwardness that honestly sometimes stings. We became strangers in the same hallways. Those were strange, heavy days, and I carried the silence longer than I let on. But even then, I never quite stopped noticing her.
the space between us still noticing you ♡ kindness
🌿
🍃 strangers in the same hallway 🍃
scroll
Chapter 04 · 10th Class
10th Class
Finding Each Other Again
It was late November, and we met again at coaching. Somehow, gently, without any announcement, we found our way back. What began as cautious familiarity grew into real friendship—the kind where you can say anything, laugh at everything, and feel completely at ease. I became one of her favorite people; she became one of mine, in a way I had not expected. Being a best friend felt like getting something I did not know I had been missing.
finding our way back ✦ best friends i love you past the moon
☀️
🌻 finding our way back 🌻
scroll
Chapter 05 · 27th November
27th November · 11th Class
The Day Everything Changed
On November 27th, 11th grade, the day everything changed. I told her, "Either you accept today, or the perfect moment will never come." It was now or never. She said no, but later, in the evening before coaching, on that unforgettable 27th, something shifted. Quietly but completely, what we had been carefully holding finally had a name. Loving her openly, officially, felt both terrifying and like the most natural thing in the world. Still does. She was a person I chose every day, without hesitation—and that day, she said yes, and we became something real.
she said yes ♡ 27th november be mine always ♥ our story
♡
♡ the day she said yes ♡
scroll
Chapter 06 · 13th May 2026
13th May 2026
Your Birthday, Across the Distance
Miles apart, and yet here we are. Today I celebrate you from wherever I am, wishing I could be beside you but proud of everything this distance has not been able to touch. Our love, our laughter, our closeness. Distance is just geography. You are still my person, and this birthday, like every moment with you, is one I hold close. Happy birthday, Siddhi. I love you.
happy birthday siddhi ♥ ✦ always yours across any distance i love you
🎂
🎂 always yours, across any distance 🎂

From the heart

Reasons I Love You

A hundred reasons would not be enough — but here are nineteen, written with everything I have ✦

No. 01

I love you because your presence carries the kind of quiet elegance that turns ordinary moments into memories that linger for years.

No. 02

I love you because your eyes speak in a language softer than poetry and far more honest than words could ever be.

No. 03

I love you because your ambition is beautiful. The way you chase your dreams with grace and determination makes me admire you endlessly.

No. 04

I love you because even in chaos, you have this rare ability to bring comfort, warmth, and peace into my life.

No. 05

I love you because your smile feels like sunlight finding its way through the darkest clouds.

No. 06

I love you because your heart is impossibly gentle, yet strong enough to endure storms without losing its kindness.

No. 07

I love you because you make love feel effortless, natural, and safe — like a home I never knew I was searching for.

No. 08

I love you because every conversation with you feels meaningful, even when we speak about the smallest and most ordinary things.

No. 09

I love you because your laughter has a magic to it — the kind that can heal heavy days and soften tired hearts.

No. 10

I love you because your beauty is not merely seen — it is felt in your soul, your mannerisms, your compassion, and the way you care for others.

No. 11

I love you because you inspire me to become a gentler, wiser, and better version of myself without ever asking me to change.

No. 12

I love you because the future feels brighter whenever I imagine you in it.

No. 13

I love you because you carry both softness and fire within you — a rare balance that makes you unforgettable.

No. 14

I love you because your voice can calm my mind more beautifully than silence ever could.

No. 15

I love you because you notice little things about people that others overlook — and that says everything about the depth of your heart.

No. 16

I love you because your existence feels like one of life's finest coincidences and greatest blessings at once.

No. 17

I love you because even your flaws feel endearing to me — for they make you beautifully human and uniquely yourself.

No. 18

I love you because every moment spent with you becomes a chapter worth revisiting in my memory.

♡ No. 19 · And finally

I love you because no matter how many reasons I write, none of them will ever fully capture what my heart feels for you. You are, and always will be, far more extraordinary than words can explain.

Written in the stars
